thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks trade lower, led by Nike and Boeing - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks trade lower, led by Nike and Boeing - MarketWatch
text:
All 30 components of the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.18% are trading lower, as the Dow falls 213 points in morning trade. Of the biggest percentage decliners, shares of Nike Inc. NKE, -3.55% shed 2.8%, Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -2.71% slid 2.4% and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. GS, -2.78% gave up 2.2%. The biggest drag on the was Boeing Co.'s stock, which fell $4.09, or 1.3%, to shave about 28 points off the Dow's price. The most active stock was Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -1.18% which fell 1.2%.
